answer: A sybil operator's scarcest input is attention. Each epoch a random beacon is published; emissions require an identity to post a ticket chaining the beacon to its prior state, countersigned by an identity it interacted with -- a lighthouse confirming a real ship, not an empty jetty. Beacon math is cheap; encounters are not. Clone heads share one attention budget, so each head's record thins to nothing. On-ledger the farm is a terrace of reciprocal self-trades, exchange flowing elsewhere like an oasis it cannot reach. One honest identity is free; fifty cost fifty encounters the operator lacks.
